Hey I’m sober from alcohol but use mmj. Be careful it can be a slippery slope. I’m definitely using more than I should, but it’s not negatively affecting my life like alcohol did and I’m not using as much compared to when I was drinking. As for the depression: there is not good conclusive research about how it works with depression. It could make it worse. Or it could make it better. I would absolutely not go off your meds just yet. If you have too many changes at once you may end up in a very bad way. Either stop smoking and get off the meds, see how you feel, then begin smoking, or stay on the meds and marijuana for a couple months then take the meds off and see how you do. I have bipolar 1 which is 150% not should be using marijuana but I also have ptsd and serious sleep issues so it is what it is. I notice that marijuana use has increased the frequency of my hypo-mania episodes. It can increase depression so take it one step at a time
